title: Coherent Exchange and Decoherence in Dirac-Spin-Liquid Quantum Interconnects
summary: We develop a susceptibility-based open-system theory for two localized qubits coupled through a candidate two-dimensional $\mathrm{U}(1)$ Dirac-spin-liquid-like bath. The central input is the gauge-invariant retarded physical spin susceptibility $\Chi^R(q,ω)$ of the bath. We show that this single response kernel controls both coherent and dissipative qubit dynamics: its real part generates the nonlocal mediated exchange, while its absorptive part determines relaxation and dephasing through the equilibrium noise spectrum.
